entities.summary: Sofia Halechko was an Austro-Hungarian soldier and Ukrainian nationalist that was a member of the Ukrainian Sich Riflemen during World War I. Her first language was Polish but she hoped to achieve independence for Ukrainians and joined the riflemen to do so.
